sources.entry: Elgg - Powerful open source social networking engine. (Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Elgg is an open source PHP framework for building socially aware web applications, including social networking sites.
summary.what_it_does: Elgg is a PHP framework for building socially aware web applications, and it is listed as a social networking engine. The README describes a core API, a system of events and extendable views for plugins to modify behavior and presentation, and an entity system for prototyping new content types. It includes an access control system for private networks and intranets, built-in groups, and file storage that plugins can serve without booting the engine. Authentication uses pluggable auth modules, and security features include anti-CSRF validation, XSS filters, and HMAC signatures. The README also mentions an RPC web services layer, notifications by email and on-site, and internationalization with Transifex integration.
use_cases: run a private intranet or community network
manage user groups and access permissions
develop plugins for a social platform
send on-site and email notifications to users
how_to_run: Installation instructions are in the external documentation linked from the README (link not included in the text)
Dependencies are managed with Composer, per the README
notable: Plugin ecosystem with 1000+ open source plugins hosted by the Elgg community
Pluggable authentication modules for custom protocols
Granular access control for private networks and intranets
Managed by the Elgg Foundation, a nonprofit organization
caveats: Installation and upgrade details are only available in external documentation, not in the README text
Described as a framework for developers, so building a site requires configuration and development work
